provenance: Original procedural sphere/capsule signed-distance blends and marching tetrahedra; no external anatomy, code download, donor, scan or texture. Blender built-ins and its bundled numpy/mathutils used.
method: Polynomial smooth minima of exact sphere/capsule signed distances; outer isovalue 0, core isovalue -2 mm; maximum with distal cut plane. Marching tetrahedra, deterministic Blender decimation, explicit world-space triangle OBJ export.
units: numeric millimetres; one Blender coordinate unit = one mm

axes.+X: subject left / lateral for this left femur

parameters.notes: Synthetic engineering defaults and exposed contour choices. No clinical reference measurements. No wire. No attenuation coefficients.

thickness_assumptions: Core is an inward isovalue of the blended field. The blend field is not an exact Euclidean distance near blends; mesh extraction/decimation introduces further approximation. Measure both exported boundaries.
artifacts_included: Outer/core OBJ material boundaries. The repository reproduces projections from these meshes; procedural model-generation source is not included.
limitations: Face 13960 retained unchanged; degeneracies may explicitly reject a frame
Parameters are synthetic defaults, not clinical reference measurements
status: Historical procedural v001; not the current Femur model
